title_en: Official Reply of the Supreme People's Court on the Jurisdiction of Chinese Courts to Accept Cases Where Chinese Citizens Residing Abroad File Lawsuits in the Courts of Two Countries Simultaneously

articles.content_en:
II. Regarding the question of whether a Chinese court shall accept and hear a case where an overseas Chinese files for divorce with the court of the country of residence, and his/her spouse in China fails to respond to the action; or where, after a foreign court has rendered a divorce decree, the spouse in China does not appeal but separately files a divorce action with a Chinese court, we agree with the opinion expressed in your court's report, namely, that the marital relationship of Chinese citizens within the territory of China shall be protected and regulated by Chinese law. In the circumstances described above, according to Article 21, Item (2) of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China (for Trial Implementation), the Chinese court shall accept and hear the case and render a ruling according to law.
Hereby reply.
September 18, 1985
